title: John Lennon and Yoko Ono register Joko Films Ltd | 1972
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono registered the company Joko Films Ltd in the United Kingdom on 6 January 1972.

The company was for the administration and distribution of the couple’s various filmmaking projects. Although Lennon never returned to the UK, at this time he considered living in New York as a temporary measure.
